svg.title: Peroxisome
svg.desc: Original vector peroxisome with a single membrane, granular matrix, paracrystalline enzyme core, and editable semantic regions.
svg.metadata: {"source_asset": {"id": "core.peroxisome.basic", "name": "Peroxisome", "category": "organelle", "tags": ["peroxisome", "organelle", "oxidation", "enzyme", "cell biology"], "description": "Original vector peroxisome with a single membrane, granular matrix, paracrystalline enzyme core, and editable semantic regions.", "file": "svg/peroxisome.svg", "source_type": "original_vector_draft", "license": "CC0-1.0", "provenance": "Original vector draft created for Figure Studio from a generic scientific concept; no proprietary reference image, scraping, tracing, or protected asset-library recreation was used.", "style_family": "figure-studio-soft-line-v1", "review_status": "visual_reviewed_2026_07_18", "style_status": "soft_line_v1_organelle_refresh", "mvp_quality": "curated", "editable_region_count": 4, "reviewer_notes": "Rebuilt with an offset oval membrane, sparse matrix granules, and a cross-hatched paracrystalline enzyme core that remains distinct from lysosome at thumbnail size.", "editable_color_regions": [{"id": "lumen", "label": "Peroxisome lumen", "default": "#D9F4E5", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "core", "label": "Enzyme crystal/core", "default": "#F4A261", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "membrane", "label": "Membrane accent", "default": "#7DD3C7", "paint": "stroke"}, {"id": "outline", "label": "Peroxisome outline", "default": "#26323D", "paint": "stroke"}]}, "source_archive": "scientific-packs(1).zip", "source_svg": "scientific-packs/core-biology/svg/peroxisome.svg", "output_style": "Style 4", "batch": "007", "source_record_is_unmodified": true}
